what: The plan excludes only the new Makefile-only test harnesses, but not the new runtime helper. Agent-lint G004 does not follow shell-to-shell calls, and compute-pr-line-counts.sh would only be reached from write-final-report.sh.
scenario_or_breakage: make lint / agent-lint can flag scripts/compute-pr-line-counts.sh and its sibling md as dead despite the runtime call.
suggested_fix: Add scripts/compute-pr-line-counts.sh and scripts/compute-pr-line-counts.md to the same agent-lint.toml exclude block with a comment that write-final-report.sh is the runtime caller and G004 cannot discover that shell edge.
